title: Tune the Baseline First: Most of Muon's Scaled Weight Decay Gain Is a Tuning Gap, but Its Small Real Advantage Grows With Model Size
abstract: arXiv:2611.02529v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scaled weight decay for Muon (Muon-SW) has been reported to train language models more efficiently than constant decoupled weight decay, but such comparisons usually reuse one learning-rate (LR) and weight-decay (WD) setting for both methods. We re-run the comparison under the MAI-Base-2 protocol: LR and WD are tuned jointly through their product for each method, on a source-scaled mixture-of-experts (MoE) scaling ladder (1.9M to 15M active parameters) that holds tokens per active parameter and data repetition fixed across sizes. We find: (1) Most of the gain is a tuning gap. At the shared setting Muon-SW wins by 0.035 bits per byte (BPB), a 1.52x compute saving; after both methods are tuned, the gap is 0.0026 BPB (95% CI [0.0018, 0.0034]), a 1.03x saving, so about 90% of the advantage disappears. translated_title: 先调优基线：Muon缩放权重衰减的收益大部分是调优差距，但其微小的真实优势会随模型规模增长
translated_abstract: 已有报道称，针对Muon优化器的缩放权重衰减（Muon-SW）比恒定解耦权重衰减能更高效地训练语言模型，但此类比较通常对两种方法复用同一组学习率（LR）和权重衰减（WD）设置。我们在MAI-Base-2协议下重新运行了这一比较：对每种方法通过LR与WD的乘积进行联合调优，并采用源缩放的混合专家（MoE）扩展阶梯（活跃参数从190万到1500万），在所有规模上保持每活跃参数token数和数据重复次数固定。我们发现：(1) 大部分收益其实是调优差距。在共享设置下，Muon-SW以每字节0.035比特（BPB）的优势获胜，相当于1.52倍的计算节省；而在两种方法均被调优后，差距缩小为0.0026 BPB（95%置信区间[0.0018, 0.0034]），相当于1.03倍的节省，即约90%的优势消失。(2) 剩余的微小优势是真实的：在最小规模下，四个配对随机种子在调优后的设置下均偏向Muon-SW。(3) 该优势……（摘要在此处截断，结合标题可知：这一优势随模型规模增大而增长）
tldr: 该研究在公平联合调优学习率与权重衰减后发现，Muon缩放权重衰减约90%的训练效率优势其实是基线调优不足造成的差距，仅剩约1.03倍的真实微小优势，且该优势随模型规模增大而增长。
en_tdlr: Under fair joint LR-WD tuning, about 90% of Muon's scaled weight decay advantage over constant decoupled weight decay is a tuning gap, leaving only a small but real ~1.03x compute saving that grows with model size.
